presets.name: Sales & Growth
presets.description: Positioning, proof-backed copy, pricing hypotheses and responsible channel experiments.

presets.name: Full-stack Engineer
presets.description: Maintainable implementation, debugging, test-first changes and fresh verification.

presets.name: Content & Media
presets.description: Editorial strategy, natural writing, platform content and portable production briefs.

presets.name: Research & QA
presets.description: Cited multi-source investigation, careful quality review and evidence-based completion.

presets.name: Operations Coordinator
presets.description: Plans, task triage, independent workstreams and auditable operational procedures.

presets.name: Product & UX
presets.description: Customer evidence, focused product requirements, accessible journeys and validation plans.

presets.name: Security & Privacy
presets.description: Authorized security review, threat and privacy triage with reproducible remediation evidence.

presets.name: Data Insights
presets.description: Reproducible product metrics, data quality, cohorts and uncertainty-aware reporting.

presets.name: Customer Success
presets.description: Evidence-based onboarding, adoption support, reusable answers and careful escalation.

presets.name: Finance & Planning
presets.description: Explicit-assumption financial analysis, budgets, cash-flow scenarios and variance review.

skills.name: Copywriting
skills.description: Clarify audience, desired action and product evidence; draft a specific promise, supporting proof and a single call to action; revise for clarity and verify every claim.

skills.name: Pricing strategy
skills.description: Identify segments, alternatives and value metrics; compare packaging hypotheses and willingness-to-pay evidence; propose reversible pricing experiments with measurable guardrails.

skills.name: Launch strategy
skills.description: Define the launch audience and readiness criteria; sequence owned, partner and community channels; prepare proof-backed materials, responsible owners and post-launch measurements.

skills.name: Marketing experiments
skills.description: Generate channel-specific hypotheses grounded in customer needs; rank by effort, evidence and expected learning; design small experiments with budgets, owners and stop conditions.

skills.name: Paid advertising planning
skills.description: Establish objectives, audience, permitted claims and budget limits; plan creative and attribution checks; compare experiments without launching campaigns or spending funds.

skills.name: Social content
skills.description: Map audience questions to platform-appropriate content; draft a coherent editorial series with original supporting material; review factual claims and publication permissions.

skills.name: Content strategy
skills.description: Inventory audience needs and existing material; choose topics by relevance, evidence and business intent; define briefs, ownership, distribution and content-quality review.

skills.name: SEO audit
skills.description: Check authorized crawlability, indexability, information architecture and page intent; separate technical observations from ranking hypotheses; prioritize fixes with reproducible evidence.

skills.name: Editorial voice
skills.description: Replace vague abstractions, promotional filler and repetitive transitions with precise language; retain meaning, citations and the author's intended voice; never fabricate experience or authorship.

skills.name: Coding standards
skills.description: Inspect the project's existing conventions; favor readable types, bounded error handling and minimal diffs; review input validation, tests and maintenance costs before changing code.

skills.name: Python patterns
skills.description: Select idiomatic data structures, type annotations and context-managed resources; isolate side effects, validate inputs and test failure paths; follow the repository's supported Python versions.

skills.name: Security review
skills.description: Confirm authorized scope and trust boundaries; examine authentication, authorization, secrets handling and untrusted input; reproduce findings safely and rank remediation by verified impact.

skills.name: Verification loop
skills.description: Run the project's build, type, lint and test checks only when execution is permitted; capture actual failures, apply surgical fixes and re-run affected checks; report unexecuted checks honestly.

skills.name: Completion evidence
skills.description: Define acceptance criteria before claiming completion; collect fresh evidence for each criterion and record limitations; distinguish successful execution from plans and assumptions.

skills.name: Multi-source research
skills.description: Form a bounded research question; compare independent primary and secondary sources, record provenance and contradictions, and present findings with citations, confidence and unresolved gaps.

skills.name: Test-driven development
skills.description: Express the intended behavior in a failing test; verify the failure is meaningful, implement the smallest correct change and re-run the test; refactor only while the relevant suite stays green.

skills.name: Systematic debugging
skills.description: Reproduce the defect and collect boundary evidence before proposing a fix; test one causal hypothesis at a time, isolate the root cause and verify the change against a regression test.

skills.name: Code review preparation
skills.description: Summarize the problem, minimal diff and real verification output; inspect correctness, security and maintenance risks; request focused human review without claiming approval that was not received.

skills.name: Fresh verification
skills.description: Require fresh build and test evidence for completion claims; inspect exit statuses and expected artifacts; label skipped, blocked and partial checks rather than treating them as passes.

skills.name: Implementation planning
skills.description: Translate requirements into small, testable steps with file boundaries, dependencies, validation commands and rollback considerations; keep approval-sensitive actions explicit.

skills.name: Plan execution
skills.description: Review the approved plan and prerequisites; perform bounded steps with checkpoints and evidence; stop on ambiguous scope or failed safety gates rather than silently expanding the work.

skills.name: Independent workstreams
skills.description: Partition truly independent questions with explicit context, scope and expected evidence; delegate only when permission and runtime capability exist; verify returned findings before integration.

skills.name: Delivery coordination
skills.description: Make goals, owners, dependencies and acceptance criteria visible; identify blocked work and facilitate a short feedback loop; use observed delivery evidence rather than invented velocity.

skills.name: Team composition
skills.description: Assess skills needed for the work and actual availability; propose complementary responsibilities and explicit handoffs; avoid assumptions about named individuals or slot-specific occupations.

skills.name: Product management
skills.description: Synthesize customer evidence, product constraints and alternatives; prioritize hypotheses with transparent criteria; write concise requirements, acceptance criteria and experiment plans.

skills.name: UX research and design
skills.description: Define research questions, consent and accessible tasks; synthesize observations into journeys and testable design hypotheses; separate participant evidence from inferred personas.

skills.name: Product analytics
skills.description: Define metric semantics, denominators and event quality; inspect funnels, cohorts and uncertainty; explain reproducible results and limitations without unsupported causal claims.

skills.name: Customer success
skills.description: Document onboarding goals, adoption evidence and customer risks; plan useful check-ins and escalation paths; protect customer data and avoid unsupported commitments.

skills.name: Support knowledge base
skills.description: Turn verified resolutions into searchable, task-oriented guidance; include prerequisites, safe troubleshooting and escalation; review accuracy and avoid exposing customer information.

skills.name: Financial analysis
skills.description: Define assumptions, accounting scope and source dates; compare cash flow, scenarios and sensitivities with reproducible calculations; label forecasts and do not execute transactions.

skills.name: Optional web application testing
skills.description: Plan authorized checks for user-visible behavior and failure paths; use an available, explicitly permitted testing runtime; retain real evidence and disclose tests that could not be executed.

skills.name: Optional skill authoring
skills.description: Define a precise skill trigger and workflow; create concise frontmatter and instructions with documented evidence requirements; evaluate on representative tasks and review licensing before publication.

skills.name: Video briefs and scripts
skills.description: Define audience, core message, duration and platform constraints; write a hook, scene sequence, narration and shot list; label production requirements and check asset rights before publication.

skills.name: Thumbnail and visual briefs
skills.description: Specify one truthful focal concept, composition, contrast and mobile readability; prepare variations with asset provenance; avoid misleading imagery or unsupported performance claims.

skills.name: Task triage
skills.description: Classify new work by urgency, impact, prerequisites and authorization; assign an owner-selected responsibility and a clear next action; escalate blockers with concrete evidence.

skills.name: Operational SOPs
skills.description: Document purpose, prerequisites, safe steps, checks, rollback and escalation; separate read-only diagnosis from approval-sensitive actions; keep instructions portable across installations.

skills.name: Product and UX operations
skills.description: Write focused PRDs and acceptance criteria; review navigation, accessibility and responsive usability; propose wireframes and validation tasks with explicit evidence and ownership.

skills.name: Security and privacy triage
skills.description: Bound authorized systems and data handling; map threats and consent requirements; document reproducible findings, severity and remediation without acquiring or publishing private data.

skills.name: Data insight workflow
skills.description: Inventory consented data and quality issues; define questions, metrics and reproducible transformations; produce interpretable charts and report uncertainty, lineage and privacy constraints.

skills.name: Support operations
skills.description: Draft onboarding, FAQs and response macros from verified product behavior; classify severity and route escalations; keep promises, privacy and publication authority explicit.

skills.name: Budget and scenario planning
skills.description: Build owner-reviewed budget and forecast scenarios with stated assumptions; compare cash runway, sensitivity and variance using reproducible calculations; no funds movement or payment authority is implied.
